scope: authorized EV research-point1 steps1-3 only; no report, other resources, threshold or new time-series learning
steps: declared structure plus continuous outcome effects
meter_noise: independent bounded uniform, std0.05kW main; std0.15kW separate process stress

reference.opt_in_selection: 3 most recent completed non-event historical pseudo-tasks, task MAE; each uses >=2 strictly older histories; no current response or current truth
reference.adoption_limit: do not change predict_reference default; evaluate past-only candidate and report its limits

measurement: all task interval means >=0.1q count toward cumulative duration; dwell30s only for continuous duration; all methods share noiseless1min reference/reduction evaluator target
causal_target: event-weighted finite cohort mean potential-outcome contrast against incentive0.4 at grid0.4..2.0 by0.2; evaluator fixed exogenous random variables; estimator never reads potential truth
continuous_core: existing Kennedy DR shared by all measured outcomes, no new estimator claim
structure: declared DAG; use both L/U adjustment; auxiliary BIC only on logit continuous incentive, first60percent original users; never change adjustment based on screen
metrics: no-action detection fraction with true R=0 denominator
miss fraction with true R>0 denominator
effect curve error against common latent interval target
zero-effect contrast deviation and support refusal
stop: one frozen new panel; preserve failures and negative results; no tuning on main truth, no dropping rejected/unavailable cases;8 blocks do not establish precise coverage or5percent false-positive guarantee
inference_limit: existing bands conditional on supplied measured outcome and nuisance fit; reference/process and smoothing error not fully propagated
